title: Jamal Igle's Work Was Likely Used to Train 79 AI Models
author: Mark Fiore
excerpt: We looked inside AI training datasets for the work of award-winning comic book artist Jamal Igle — and found his art was likely used to train 79 AI models used by almost 25 million people a month.

title: What Cartoonists Think of AI
author: Mark Fiore
excerpt: We brought a scroll of paper and a fistful of Sharpies to the National Cartoonists Society convention and asked cartoonists how they feel about AI. Here's what they drew.

title: Croquis: See What AI Ate
author: Mark Fiore & Sally Herships
excerpt: Find out if the machines are chewing on your sketchbook. Croquis scans AI models to see if your work was scraped without your permission — and gives you the hard data to take your agency back.
